classdef.name: LayoutGridDataInformation
classdef.shortdesc: Default properties specific to layout grids.

property.name: isValid
property.shortdesc: Returns true if the object specifier resolves to valid objects.

property.name: parent
property.shortdesc: The parent of the LayoutGridDataInformation (a Application or Document).

property.name: appliedFont
property.shortdesc: The font applied to the LayoutGridDataInformation, specified as either a font object or the name of font family. Can return: Font or String.

property.name: fontStyle
property.shortdesc: The name of the font style.

property.name: characterAki
property.shortdesc: The amount of white space between characters.

property.name: lineAki
property.shortdesc: The amount of white space between lines.

property.name: horizontalScale
property.shortdesc: The horizontal scaling applied to the LayoutGridDataInformation.

property.name: verticalScale
property.shortdesc: The vertical scaling applied to the LayoutGridDataInformation.

property.name: properties
property.shortdesc: A property that allows setting of several properties at the same time.

method.name: toSource
method.shortdesc: Generates a string which, if executed, will return the LayoutGridDataInformation.

method.name: getElements
method.shortdesc: Resolves the object specifier, creating an array of object references.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The registered event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.
